[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Reclaim the measured backlog under one gate[/bold #D7AFFF]                   [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]triage[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]

    [#D7D7AF]re-measure and record the result.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Close the managed-temp reaper's coverage gaps[/bold #D7AFFF]                 [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]tmpreap[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]tmpreap: prune children of unregistered managed-temp buckets, register [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the missing buckets, and add a test that the horizon table covers every [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bucket the code creates.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Reap proc runtime directories with proc-row retention[/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]procreap[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]procreap: delete a pruned proc's runtime directory alongside its logs [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and sweep the runtime directories whose proc rows are already gone.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Stop the Rust dev-build target leak at its source[/bold #D7AFFF]             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]

    [#D7D7AF]document the rule that agents never invent a CARGO_TARGET_DIR.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bound per-project agent artifact directories[/bold #D7AFFF]                  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]artifacts[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]

    [#D7D7AF]referenced and recent runs, and drop the empty out-of-range shards that [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]starve shard watches.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Share Git objects across managed workspace checkouts[/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]wsobjects[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]

    [#D7D7AF]of the primary's pack, and retrofit the existing checkouts.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Make the footprint visible and self-correcting[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
